Capitalize on the latest market trends

Dear Investors,

Big week at Hedgeye.

Our CEO Keith McCullough hosted our Quarterly Macro Themes presentation, which features 208 slides of insight and analysis on the three big trends we’re forecasting to drive market returns over the next 3-6 months.

Here are those big themes:

	Transition to USA Quad 3
	H4L, Again! (Higher for Longer)
	Country Quad Setups

This is foundational research. These are the trends that inform Keith’s decision making behind all of our long and short investment ideas.

If you want more information about our Quarterly Macro Themes, keep reading this edition of Weekend Reading.

Keith McCullough’s Early Look: Q3 Macro Themes Day

“My most Senior Partners on the Macro Team (Josh Steiner and Christian Drake) lead the charge on content creation. Drago and Rooster put in long hours digging up data. All I really do is edit their research findings and tweak a few slide titles. As I often tell my teammates, “you write the lyrics and I’ll sing the song.” On slide 42 of 206, we have a concise summary of our Q3 2024 Macro Themes.

READ HERE: https://info.hedgeye.com/e/764243/l-764243-2024-06-21-2sk691q/2sk6rl2/1733014789/h/sVP5fQ9UQxCWQ7c4eP0iYmV95nS_1PrcA8A9btHuH3E

Dr. Pippa Malmgren 1-on-1 with Keith McCullough

“I know this sounds so dramatic but we’re kind of already in World War III. I wrote that in October 2022. We’re already in an extraordinary period of conflict between the superpowers. But unlike World War I and II, our traditional thinking about tanks versus tanks and aircraft carriers versus aircraft carriers is totally inappropriate for this new environment… I’ve been describing it as we’re in a hot war in cold places – meaning Space, the Arctic, and the high North. And we’re in a cold war in hot places – meaning conflicting directly with superpowers in Africa, in the Pacific and now the Middle East as well. That’s a much bigger way of thinking about today than just Ukraine.”

WATCH NOW: https://info.hedgeye.com/e/764243/-conversations-pippa-malmgren-/2sk6rl5/1733014789/h/sVP5fQ9UQxCWQ7c4eP0iYmV95nS_1PrcA8A9btHuH3E

The Rise of the K-Shaped Economy: Why the Current Market Disproportionately Benefits the Fortunate Few…

In a 30-page section within the Macro Themes, our Macro team breaks down a critical dynamic within the U.S. economy right now:

The K-Shaped economy.

What’s that? It’s where the wealthiest Americans are the winners, and the lowest-income Americans get squeezed by higher inflation.

Here’s a quick summary of this dynamic...

	The Rich disproportionately Benefit from Higher Rates as they get paid on their excess liquidity.
	The Rich disproportionately Benefit from reflation in asset prices as they own a disproportionate share of financial assets.
	Big Banks consolidate shares amidst Banking Stress & Liquidity flight.
	Large Cap as a factor exposure outperforms amidst Quad 4 precarity.

Meanwhile...

	Bottom Slant of the K gets hit with higher (cost of living) inflation while broadly missing out on the income upside associated with higher rates.
	Bottom Slant of the K loses discretionary consumption capacity as share of wallet goes to service higher debt costs.
	Bottom Slant of the K becomes increasingly vulnerable to income shocks (i.e., end of student loan moratoria) as any residual cash cushion is exhausted.

This K-Shaped Economy is something that will increasingly drive winners and losers across the U.S. economy and financial markets.

Understanding this dynamic and effectively navigating it (for your family and wealth) will be critical to future investing success.

If you’d like to learn more about our Quarterly Macro Themes presentation (and the K-shaped economy), we suggest checking out our Macro Pro research package.

The Quarterly Macro Themes presentation is available exclusively to our Institutional and Macro Pro subscribers.

If you’re interested in upgrading, email support@hedgeye.com: https://info.hedgeye.com/e/764243/2024-06-23/2sk6rl8/1733014789/h/sVP5fQ9UQxCWQ7c4eP0iYmV95nS_1PrcA8A9btHuH3E

Hedgeye Risk Management is an independent investment research and online financial media company, focused exclusively on generating and delivering thoughtful investment ideas in a proven buy-side process.  The firm combines quantitative, bottom-up and macro analysis with an emphasis on timing.  

The Hedgeye team features some of the most highly-regarded research analysts on Wall Street, covering Macro, Financials, Healthcare, Retail, Gaming, Lodging & Leisure (GLL), Restaurants, Global Technology, REITS, Industrials, Communications, Cannabis, Consumer Staples, Housing, Materials, Software, Energy, Demography and Washington policy analysis, including Macro, Telecom & Media, and Healthcare.
